tone: Nurture on/off for crop + stored material; hopeful soft glow when on — not sci-fi.

BaseColor.notes: Healthy crop / tended plant. Off state leans duller via instance or NightMix pairing.

Variation.notes: Growth breakup; on/off should stay readable at garden distance.

NightMix.notes: Night overlay + optional soft life glow. Spirit seed → night crop uses this master, not a new one.

Emissive.notes: On when nurtured; near-black when off. Warm-green, low intensity — hopeful, not neon.
